mizo: API tih chu Application Programming Interface tihna a ni. Hei hi instruction emaw programming instruction hrang hrang, application pahnih te inbe pawp a, data inthleng tawn theihtirtu a ni. API-te hian developer-te tan application dang emaw platform dangte chhawp chhuah data leh service-te access leh khawih danglam theihna kawng a siam a ni. Hemi te hi tunlai web development pêng pawimawh tak an ni a, developer-te chu modular component-te hmanga application leh website complex tak tak develop theihtirtu a ni.
english: API stands for Application Programming Interface. It is a set of instructions or programming instructions that allow two applications to communicate and exchange data with each other. APIs provide a way for developers to access and manipulate data and services offered by other applications or platforms. They are an essential part of modern web development and allow developers to develop complex applications and websites using modular components.
